LanguageData.HE_Albion_Sabre.label: cavalry sabre
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Sabre.description:
A curved, single-edged sword with a basket guard, made for cutting from the saddle.
Requires 10 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Tweed.label: tweed mills
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Tweed.description: Weave rough, warm wool cloth in muted checks that shrugs off rain.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Brick.label: bricks and cobbles
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Brick.description: Fire red bricks for courtyards and set rounded cobbles into the streets.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_MeatPie.label: meat pie
LanguageData.HE_Albion_MeatPie.description: Seal meat and gravy into a thick pastry crust that keeps for days and travels well.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Pub.label: public house
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Pub.description: A long oak table, a barrel of ale and a dartboard: the true parliament of Albion.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Enclosure.label: enclosure
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Enclosure.description:
Hedge the common fields and farm them for profit. The harvest grows; the neighbours grumble.
Tradition: Colonists harvest 5% more from plants but lose 5% negotiation ability.
Requires 20 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Sanitation.label: sanitation
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Sanitation.description:
Boil the water, drain the streets, wash the hands. Fevers pass faster in a clean town.
Tradition: Colonists gain immunity 10% faster.
Requires 25 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_JointStock.label: joint-stock company
LanguageData.HE_Albion_JointStock.description:
Pool the money of many, share the risk of every voyage and the profit of every bargain.
Tradition: Colonists get 5% better trade prices.
Requires 25 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Charts.label: Royal Navy charts
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Charts.description:
Surveyed coasts, measured rivers and well-kept roads: Albion's caravans never lose their way.
Tradition: Caravans travel 10% faster.
Requires 30 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Musket.label: flintlock musket
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Musket.description:
A smoothbore flintlock: slow to load, loud, inaccurate past fifty paces and terrifying in a volley.
Requires 20 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Redcoat.label: redcoat uniform
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Redcoat.description:
A red wool coat with white facings and a tall shako. A line of them is seen from a mile away, and meant to be.
Requires 15 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_SteamEngine.label: steam engine
LanguageData.HE_Albion_SteamEngine.description:
Boil water with wood, push a piston with the steam and turn a dynamo with the piston.
Requires 25 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Rifle.label: rifled musket
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Rifle.description:
Cut spiral grooves into the barrel and fix a bayonet: longer range, better aim and a spear at the end.
Requires 35 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Drill.label: drill sergeant
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Drill.description:
Load, present, fire. Again. Again. Until it is done without thinking.
Tradition: Colonists gain +2 shooting accuracy.
Requires 35 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_SteamPower.label: steam power
LanguageData.HE_Albion_SteamPower.description:
Belts and shafts carry the engine's power to every bench. Less waste, more work.
Tradition: Your work tables use 5% fewer resources.
Requires 40 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FactoryOrder.label: factory order
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FactoryOrder.description:
The whistle at dawn, the shift, the quota. Benches never stand idle, and neither do the workers.
Tradition: Your work tables work 12% faster, but colonists' mental break threshold rises by 2%.
Requires 45 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Workshop.label: workshop of the world
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Workshop.description:
The engines of Albion turn day and night, and the whole colony keeps time with them.
Tradition: Colonists work 4% faster and gain +1 shooting accuracy.
Requires 50 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
Unlocked by finishing the nation's story.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_TextileMill.label: textile mill
LanguageData.HE_Albion_TextileMill.description:
A steam-driven power loom that weaves a bale of wool into tweed faster than ten hand weavers.
Requires 40 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FieldCannon.label: field cannon
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FieldCannon.description:
Drilled gun crews and cast bronze barrels: the artillery that won the empire's battles.
Requires 40 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_SteamArmy.label: Albion steam army
LanguageData.HE_Albion_SteamArmy.description:
Cartridges, rifled barrels and a uniform: the army Albion raised when the factories came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Albion has reached the Age of Steam.
Requires 45 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_ElectricArmy.label: Albion electric army
LanguageData.HE_Albion_ElectricArmy.description:
Machine-made arms, a steel helmet and a field uniform in drab: the army Albion raised when the wires came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Albion has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 60 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Works.label: Albion works
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Works.description:
The first electric works of Albion: one machine the nation is proud of, built to its own taste.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Albion has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 50 Albion knowledge unless this is your heritage.
